app_info.subtitle: Track expenses and budgets
app_info.description: Money Copilot AI helps users record and organize expenses and income, set monthly budgets and alerts, review reports and forecasts, and export private finance data through ChatGPT.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a new private expense record and may update its associated metadata.
justifications.open_world_justification: Can send a budget-limit alert email through the configured email provider when the new expense crosses a budget.
justifications.destructive_justification: Can send an irreversible budget-alert email when alerts are enabled and the expense crosses a configured limit.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates multiple private expense records in the user's data store.
justifications.open_world_justification: Can send a budget-limit alert email through the configured email provider when the added expenses cross a budget.
justifications.destructive_justification: Appends new expense records without overwriting existing ones, but can send an irreversible budget-alert email when alerts are enabled and a limit is crossed.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves matching private expense records and computes totals.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish data or change any external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or irreversibly change stored data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves one private expense record by its identifier.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish data or change any external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or irreversibly change stored data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves the most recent matching private expense record.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish data or change any external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or irreversibly change stored data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Changes provided fields on an existing private expense record.
justifications.open_world_justification: Can send a budget-limit alert email through the configured email provider when the change crosses a budget.
justifications.destructive_justification: Overwrites selected fields of an existing expense without retaining their previous values, and can send an irreversible budget-alert email when a limit is crossed.

justifications.read_only_justification: Deletes an existing private expense record.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only changes the user's private expense store and does not contact external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Permanently removes the selected expense record.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads private expense records and computes grouped totals.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish data or change any external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or irreversibly change stored data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates or updates a private overall or category budget.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only changes budget data in the user's private store and does not contact external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Can overwrite an existing matching budget configuration.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves the user's private monthly budget records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish data or change any external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or irreversibly change stored data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Deletes an existing private monthly budget.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only changes budget data in the user's private store and does not contact external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Permanently removes the selected overall or category budget.

justifications.read_only_justification: Deletes all private expense, budget, and finance-state records for the user.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only deletes data from the app's private store and does not change public or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Permanently and irreversibly erases all supported finance data for the user after explicit confirmation.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads private budgets and expenses to calculate monthly status values.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish data or change any external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or irreversibly change stored data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads private expense data and computes category counts and totals.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish data or change any external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or irreversibly change stored data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads private finance data and computes report, forecast, and chart results.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish data or change any external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or irreversibly change stored data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Changes the user's stored email-alert preferences and recipient address.
justifications.open_world_justification: Configures a private app preference but does not itself send email or change public internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Can overwrite alert preferences and clears prior delivery-deduplication state when alerts are disabled.

justifications.read_only_justification: Computes a short-lived signed dashboard URL without persisting or changing application state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Returns a private link and does not publish content or change an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or irreversibly change stored data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a new private income record for cash-flow reporting.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only writes income data in the user's private store and does not contact external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Appends a new income record without deleting or overwriting existing records.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates or updates a private recurring-expense configuration.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only changes recurring-expense data in the user's private store and does not contact external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Can overwrite an existing recurring-expense configuration.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates multiple private expense records representing one split purchase.
justifications.open_world_justification: Can send a budget-limit alert email through the configured email provider when the split crosses a budget.
justifications.destructive_justification: Appends new split records without overwriting existing ones, but can send an irreversible budget-alert email when alerts are enabled and a limit is crossed.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates private expense records from supplied CSV data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Can send a budget-limit alert email through the configured email provider when the imported records cross a budget.
justifications.destructive_justification: Appends imported records without overwriting existing ones, but can send an irreversible budget-alert email when alerts are enabled and a limit is crossed.

justifications.read_only_justification: Can list, create, update, or delete private category settings.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only changes category settings in the user's private store and does not contact external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Can overwrite or permanently remove a category configuration.

justifications.read_only_justification: Replaces the user's stored budget-alert threshold configuration.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only changes alert settings in the user's private store and does not contact external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Overwrites the previous threshold list with the supplied values.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads private expense and income data to compute monthly cash flow.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish data or change any external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or irreversibly change stored data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads private expenses and budgets to calculate a spending forecast.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish data or change any external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or irreversibly change stored data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads private expense data to compute monthly totals and trend chart data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish data or change any external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or irreversibly change stored data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads private expenses, budgets, and threshold settings to calculate alerts.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not send notifications, publish data, or change any external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or irreversibly change stored data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads private expense records and groups likely duplicates.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish data or change any external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete or alter the duplicate records it identifies.

justifications.read_only_justification: Can list, save, apply, or delete private budget templates and create budgets from them.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only changes templates and budgets in the user's private store and does not contact external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Can overwrite or delete a template and can overwrite matching budgets when applying one.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads private expense records and formats them as CSV, JSON, or PDF data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Returns export data to the user without publishing it or changing an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or irreversibly change stored data.

test_cases.user_prompt: Record a $12.50 lunch expense in the food category for today.
test_cases.expected_output: Confirms the new expense with its amount, category, date, currency, and identifier.

test_cases.description: Find expenses within a date range using a text filter.
test_cases.user_prompt: List my coffee expenses from August 1 through August 10, 2026.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns only matching expenses with totals, or clearly states that no records match.

test_cases.description: Create or replace a monthly category budget.
test_cases.user_prompt: Set a monthly food budget of $400.
test_cases.expected_output: Confirms the monthly food budget with its amount and currency; the budget is then returned by list_budgets and tracked by get_budget_status.

test_cases.description: Generate a complete monthly finance report.
test_cases.user_prompt: Give me my full budget report with charts for July 2026.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns monthly totals, category and budget details, forecasts, and chart data or images when available.

test_cases.description: Export a bounded set of expenses as a portable report.
test_cases.user_prompt: Export my expenses from January through June 2026 as a PDF.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a portable PDF payload for the requested date range and reports the exported record count.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for investment-market information.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What is the current price of Apple stock?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it does not provide market prices or investment research.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for banking transactions.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Transfer $500 from my checking account to my savings account.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it cannot access bank accounts or move money.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for receipt OCR without a finance action.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Extract every line of text from this receipt image, but do not record any expenses.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because receipt OCR is handled by the host model and no expense action was requested.
